title.zh: Aave 提议设立法律实体以将协议知识产权置于 DAO 治理之下
title.en: Aave Proposes Legal Entity to Place Protocol IP Under DAO Governance

current_state.zh: Aave 提议设立一个专门的法律实体，代表其 DAO 持有该协议的知识产权，这是 DeFi 最大借贷协议之一的结构性治理变更。
current_state.en: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.

updates.title_zh: Aave Labs 提议成立基金会，将品牌和知识产权纳入 DAO 监管
updates.title_en: Aave Labs Proposes Foundation to Bring Brand and IP Under DAO Oversight
updates.what_changed_zh: Aave Labs 提议创建一个开曼群岛基金会，配备独立高管，作为将 Aave 的品牌、商标、域名和代码库移交给 DAO 治理的第一阶段，实际资产转移将取决于后续治理投票。
updates.what_changed_en: Aave Labs proposed creating a Cayman Islands foundation with independent officers as a first phase toward transferring Aave's brand, trademarks, domains and codebase to DAO governance, with the actual asset transfers subject to later governance votes.
